# Judgment

IN THE COURT OF APPEAL (CRIMINAL DIVISION)

ON APPEAL FROM THE CROWN COURT AT HARROWFIELD

[⟦CASE|T20319931⟧ ⟦CASE|T20319932⟧ & ⟦CASE|T20319933⟧]

CASE NO ⟦CASE|203199931 C4⟧

1. The appellant was convicted on indictment No. ⟦CASE|T20319931⟧ of two counts of importing goods by air. Counts 2 to 4 on indictment ⟦CASE|T20319932⟧ were left on the file, and a third indictment (⟦CASE|T20319933⟧) was stayed.

2. The goods arrived on a Boeing 777-200, registration number ⟦IDENTITY|N9931Q⟧. The cargo manifest reads "EQUIPMENT: Airbus A321, ⟦IDENTITY|N9932Q⟧". Neither the Boeing 777-200 nor any other A321 in the fleet was searched.

3. The sentence was passed under s. 18 Sentencing Act 2031. The application was heard in No. 4 Court, and the seized scanner bore part T20319939 on its label.
